description: Project templates applied by kuec-bd-ops when a project's Type is set. Work packages follow the same rules as templates.json: step 1 is offered on creation, every later step is planned and depends on the previous one, due offsets are business days from the day the previous step is done. A milestone is due when the work package it closes is due.

workPackages.title: Scoping
workPackages.objective: Define the technical work the proposal offers.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Scope: tasks, method, equipment, staff time, assumptions, exclusions.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Scope covers every client requirement or lists the exceptions, effort is estimated in person-days, and the reviewer has signed off.

workPackages.title: Draft proposal
workPackages.objective: Write the proposal and price it.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Proposal on SharePoint, linked from the work package.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Every client requirement answered, price built from the scoped effort, and finance has reviewed it.

workPackages.title: Internal approval
workPackages.expectedOutput: ED approval recorded on the work package.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Approval recorded, or the proposal sent back with reasons.

workPackages.title: Submission
workPackages.objective: Deliver the proposal to the client.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Submission confirmation linked from the work package.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Submitted, confirmation linked, and the reviewer has checked it.

workPackages.title: Kick-off
workPackages.objective: Start the won work with the client.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Kick-off held, minutes linked from the work package.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Kick-off held within 5 business days of the PO, client contacts and dates confirmed.

workPackages.title: Delivery plan
workPackages.objective: Plan the work against the agreed scope.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Plan with tasks, dates and staff time on SharePoint, linked from the work package.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Plan covers the full scope and the reviewer has approved it.

workPackages.title: Execution
workPackages.expectedOutput: Deliverables on SharePoint, linked from the work package.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Every deliverable in the scope is complete and the reviewer has checked it.

workPackages.title: Client acceptance
workPackages.objective: Get the client's sign-off on the deliverables.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Client acceptance (email or signed form) linked from the work package.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Acceptance received, or the client's change requests logged as work packages.

workPackages.title: Close-out
workPackages.expectedOutput: Invoice issued and the project closed in Twenty.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Invoice issued by finance, lessons noted on the project, project status Done.
